source: DOE Oil Industry Management Bureau weekly city price panel (doe_regional_ron95.csv) joined to Yahoo Finance daily closes
transformations: target: matched panel — per-city price change across consecutive 7-day DOE cycles, then median across cities present in both weeks
target: drop weeks with fewer than min_cities matched, and any |change| > 20 PHP/L as a parse artifact
features: % change of each daily close over the 7-day window ending FEATURE_LAG_DAYS before the cycle date (strictly prior information — this lag is the experiment)
units: pump_change in PHP/L per week; *_pct in percent
notes: Weekly backtest panel. The lag is load-bearing: a window reaching the cycle date would read the answer it predicts.
